claim_boundary: Native pinned ToolSandbox simulator and milestone verifier evidence only. The one-step scripted user intentionally truncates multi-tool and multi-user-turn scenarios; no model-based user simulator, official split, full 1032-variant matrix, RapidAPI tool, MCP server, or external account was executed. The matched random control is an initialization diagnostic, not a leaderboard comparison.

coverage.selection: all 129 upstream base/no-distraction scenarios; sorted names; random seed 2028 before named_scenarios

decision.reason: The simulator and verifier executed for all 129 base scenarios, but the run uses a deterministic one-step scripted user, omits the upstream model-based user simulator and official split declaration, and therefore cannot be reported as an official ToolSandbox score.
